findings.detail: Full V5-B01/V5-B02 required-change text, fixed-target first sentence and HANDOFF acceptance item 1 reproduce verbatim with whitespace wrapping. The omitted fixed-target second sentence is substantively retained by OPEN/ineligibility text, not waived. Original full body/caller/domain/native scope, strict warnings, zero unproved/justified/Assume, no suppression and all original controls remain binding.

Pinning alone adds no operator gate. Reference redefinition, material API/ABI or owner policy, operator custody/runtime architecture, merge/release/install/sudo/production/PRIME remain reserved. Routine preserving implementation is independently reviewed engineering with pins/enrollment refreshed and fixed fixtures.

Additional manager drop-in lines, target filter, 0710 image directory, observer revocation, setup atoms/reconciliation and external seal are specified inside the existing privileged setup/rollback request. S-R choices do not authorize runtime exceptions; F-1 now is optional accounts-in-principle only.

Proposed reduction of ext4 root-only reserved blocks keeps at least 10 GiB privileged reserve and project-vault/WORLDLINE 10000000000-byte reserve unchanged. NOT EXECUTED, conditional fresh privileged identity/health/block-size/old-count capture, rollback and after-readback; no physical capacity creation, deletion or admission. Applicable sudo reservation is original. Option 6 lowers task reserve and remains ineligible. No tune2fs was run here.

K6 says a refused next launch is never narrowed acceptance and K1 claims inside-tree mutation despite its stated alias timing. Those assertions cannot override the original preservation and own-inode requirements. Their corrections remain mandatory, with no proposed exception.
